name: Rising
audio: birdsong swelling into a warm choral harmony, rustling leaves; no speech
world: The forest is alive: leaves, petals and spores drift, vines uncurl, fireflies and butterflies rise into the sunbeams, a stag and doe step into the clearing and owls and hummingbirds cross the light.

actions.beat: Colossal roots uncoil and flowers burst open across the forest floor as the valley wakes, fireflies and butterflies lifting into the sunbeams.
{{She}} rises steadily out of a huge opening blossom, arms opening wide with palms up as if gathering the morning.
Petals and spores swirl up around {{her}} as {{her}} eyes glow with {{MAGIC}} light and {{she}} smiles joyfully to the camera; a stag and doe look on.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
